summary: Verified Edit Emission Dialog audit_log population end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass for GET /api/user/calc-engine/audit-log/{id} — returns qty=231 kL for 1d1dcfc7, qty=1000 kg for a940bff9, found:false for bogus id, no mongo _id leak. Frontend: Edit dialog on 231 kL diesel row correctly fires audit-log API (200), auto-populates Quantity=231 and Unit dropdown=kL, shows Calculated Emissions 672.21/0.03/0.01/674.50 tCO2e, no 'Property:' prefix, no '(source_mapping)' leakage, transformation arrow present. All 8 review acceptance items PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: Displays 'undefined NaN' in the date field when editing an existing emission — date field not being populated from emission record

integration_issues.issue: Emissions list shows 0.0000 tCO2e for all rows even though dialog-side calc engine returns correct values (674.50 tCO2e). Emission record documents are not being updated with calculation outputs after save (main agent already noted this as known separate issue).

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — likely SelectItem rendering inside a native <select>

action_items: Fix Reporting Month population in Edit Dialog — currently shows 'undefined NaN' (not tied to audit_log refactor; pre-existing).
Fix the Select/SelectItem nesting causing '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' React hydration warning inside the edit dialog.
Persist calculation outputs back onto the emission record so the Emissions list rows don't all show 0.0000 tCO2e (already acknowledged as separate issue).
(Optional) Add aria-describedby to the Update Emission Record DialogContent.
critical_code_review_comments: Emissions.js is 4500+ lines — violates the <700 lines guideline. Consider splitting into EditEmissionDialog, AddEmissionDialog, EmissionCard, useAuditLogPopulate hook, etc.

fetchAuditLogAndPopulate uses getAuthHeader in useEffect deps — if getAuthHeader is not memoized (useCallback), this effect will re-run on every render and re-fetch the audit log. Verify it's wrapped in useCallback.

Frontend falls back to emission record values when found:false; good. But when found:true and a field is in propertyMap with source !== 'user_override', it sets values[key]='' silently — user sees an empty field that previously had a value. Consider showing a 'from fuel DB' hint.
Backend endpoint returns inputs/context/outputs verbatim from Mongo; fine here since query projects out _id. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of review acceptance criteria verified; 2 orthogonal bugs found
